quote_condition.description: The owner's condition on the cleared quotes: shown only where no other record says the same.

quotes_cleared.description: Who allowed quotes from this private document to be published, and on what day.

reference_code.description: The holder's own reference for the record, as the holder writes it.

repository.description: The old free-text holder, read for one release; holder_id replaces it.

short_name.description: A short name the site shows for the source.

subjects.description: The persons, places or events the source shows or speaks of, by their ids.

url_pattern.description: How an address of one of the source's records is formed.

work_id.description: The id of the work in the project's files; never published where it is a file name.

relation.description: Whether this source is a copy or a transcription of the original.

SourcedDate.description: A date a source gives: a normalized start (and end, for a range) with how precise it is, or the words as printed with their calendar, or both.

end.description: The end of a range of dates, written as the start is.

inferred.description: True when the date was worked out rather than read.

precision.description: How much of the date is known: year, month, day or range.

printed.description: The date's words as the source prints or writes them.

printed_calendar.description: The calendar of the printed words.

start.description: The date's start, as far as it is known: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD.

SourcedRelation.description: One source's statement that a person is related to another, from the subject to the relative, of a released kinship type, or of type other with a proposed type.

attribution.description: Who recorded the statement, and on what day.

citations.description: The evidence: where in which sources the relation is found.

date.description: When, as the source gives it.

event_id.description: The life event the statement concerns, by its id in the record.

evidence_confidence.description: How sure the evidence makes the statement.

family_id.description: The family the relation concerns, by its id.

holocaust_related.description: True when the statement concerns the Holocaust.

id.description: The fact's id in the record.

identity_confidence.description: How sure it is that the statement is about this person.

organization_id.description: The organisation the statement concerns, by its id in the record.

place_id.description: Where, by the place's id in the record.

proposed_type.description: For a statement of type other: the type proposed for it, awaiting the owner's approval.

qualifiers.description: More about the statement, as named texts.

related_name.description: For kinship: the relative's name, where the relative has no person of their own.

related_person_id.description: For kinship: the relative, by the person's id in the record.

relationship_type.description: For kinship: how the relative is related, from the subject to the relative.

review.description: Whether a person has reviewed the statement.

shown.description: Who allowed the relative to be shown on the person's page, and on what day; never evidence of a death.

status.description: The statement's standing: proposed, accepted, disputed or rejected.

subject_id.description: The person the relation goes from, by the person's id.

type.description: kinship for a released relationship type; other, with a proposed type, for one not yet released.

value.description: The statement's words or value, such as an occupation.
